protocol.hypothesis: Uncontrolled process addresses and/or separate executable identities contribute to the remaining identical-binary timing variation. An A/A deviation alone cannot be attributed to a source change.
protocol.intervention: Use one identical production baseline executable in a 2x2 design: separate versus same pathname/inode, ASLR enabled versus disabled. Interleave all four cells within each balanced cycle and record process addresses, faults, context switches, CPU time and wall time.
protocol.constraints: This instrumented consumer is diagnostic only. It cannot replace the original consumer performance results, erase initial flags, or prove a candidate gain. Do not infer physical cache conflicts without counters.
